Scope

Financial Technology

Financial technology work covers payments, merchant operating systems, digital onboarding, KYC processes, collections, reconciliation, settlement and integration with core banking, MFI and enterprise platforms.

Designed for

  • Banks and microfinance institutions
  • Insurance and merchant environments
  • Organizations managing collections, settlement or reconciliation workflows
  • Institutions connecting payment activity to core systems

Key capabilities

Financial Technology

Collections

Settlement

Transaction capture, processing and settlement follow a controlled financial workflow.

Merchant operations

Technology around merchants, payment activity and related operational workflows.

Core integration
